Class EffectBuilder

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.EffectBuilder
public final class EffectBuilder extends Object
Builds an effect from functions that choose its color, position, opacity, or size.

For example, supply a color function returning red and an offset function moving letters up and down. The library calls those functions when measuring or drawing text, on the thread performing that operation. Keep client-only work out of callbacks that may also be used by common-side text measurements.

Call build once before sharing the effect. The chosen functions are fixed afterward, but variables captured by those functions remain your responsibility; the builder does not make shared mutable state thread-safe.
